notes: Recorded clock starts at directory initialization, after initial setup sourcing and reading the prior writeup. Wall stages will be partitioned; writing preparation overlapped the GPU run.
GPU_run_definition: Wall interval from first retrieval attempt through DONE, including reader download/warmup and one checkpoint-preserving operational restart. GPU-run time is not a pure kernel benchmark.
overlap_note: Writing preparation overlapped GPU work; the four reported stages partition elapsed wall time rather than summing labor time.
